page.overview:
What is Raid on Dantooine?

In 3962 BBY, Dorjander Kace and his Mandalorian Knights raided the Jedi Enclave on Dantooine during the Mandalorian Wars when the Mandalorians made an effort to kidnap young Jedi Padawans.
